Task: Run final validation and manage the pull-request workflow for the completed `template` command feature in /Users/robinhultman/dev/intropy/tooling/intropy-cli.

## What was implemented (all work is on branch `feat/template-command`, tracking origin/feature/v-next)

Goal: `int describe` used to describe *templates*, which did not fit the `int` (integrations) noun. Decision (made with the user): house verbs are `list` + `show` on every noun; templates get their own root command; hard cut on the old command.

Changes, all uncommitted in the working tree:
- `cmd/intropy/template.go` (new): root `template` command, "Inspect the Intropy template library".
- `cmd/intropy/template_list.go` (new): `template list` — names-only listing via `internal/template.List` (new `internal/template/list.go`), which resolves the release tag and lists template dirs via the GitHub contents API. Flags `--template-version`, `-o plain|json`.
- `cmd/intropy/template_show.go` (new): `template show <template>` — the former `int describe` logic verbatim under its new name. Flags `--template-version`, `-o plain|json`.
- `cmd/intropy/int_show.go` (new): `int show [dir]` — prints the integration's `.intropy/scaffold.json` record found via `template.FindScaffold` (walks up from dir, default "."). Plain output is a human summary; `-o json` prints the record unchanged.
- `cmd/intropy/int_describe.go` (rewritten): hidden stub, always exits with usage error (exit 2) pointing at `template show <name>` and `int show`. This is the agreed hard cut.
- `internal/template/github.go`: `GitHub.ListTemplates` signature changed to accept a `ref` (release tag) so listings are version-correct; added `?ref=` query param. It had zero callers before.
- `internal/template/doc.go`: doc comment updated (three workflows now).
- `AGENTS.md`: new "Command verbs" section documenting `list`/`show` as the house verbs.
- `README.md`: quickstart, command tree, new "Templates" section (list/show), new "Show an integration" section, troubleshooting table, references — all `int describe` references replaced.
- `PLAN-cli-consistency.md`: command-tree inventory updated only (historical findings left intact).
- Tests: `internal/template/list_test.go` (new; contents-API listing + ref pinning), `cmd/intropy/int_show_test.go` (new; plain/JSON/walk-up/not-found/describe-stub).

IMPORTANT: `web/dist/index.html` is modified in the working tree but is UNRELATED local build noise — do NOT stage or commit it.

## Your job

1. Run `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` (full suite). All were green before handoff.
2. Review the diff for production quality: no debug code, no leftover TODO/FIXME, comments follow the repo's AGENTS.md style (why-not-what, no PR/issue references, doc comments on exported symbols).
3. Commit in logical, reviewable commits with specific `git add <path>` (NEVER `git add .`, NEVER commit web/dist/index.html). Follow the repo's commit conventions (check `git log` for style).
4. Push `feat/template-command` and open a PR targeting `feature/v-next` (NOT main) with a clear description of the rename rationale, the hard cut on `int describe`, and the new surface (`template list`, `template show`, `int show`).
5. Report back the PR URL.

## Acceptance Contract
Acceptance level: verified
Completion is not accepted from prose alone. End with a structured acceptance report.

Criteria:
- criterion-1: Implement the requested change without widening scope
- criterion-2: Return evidence sufficient for an independent acceptance review

Required evidence: changed-files, tests-added, commands-run, validation-output, residual-risks, no-staged-files

Review gate: required by reviewer.

Finish with a fenced JSON block tagged `acceptance-report` in this shape:
Use empty arrays when no items apply; array fields contain strings unless object entries are shown.
`criteriaSatisfied[].status` must be exactly one of: satisfied, not-satisfied, not-applicable.
`commandsRun[].result` must be exactly one of: passed, failed, not-run.
`manualNotes` and `notes` are optional strings; an empty string means no note and does not satisfy `manual-notes` evidence.
